senses.gloss: f.(b. h. קֹרָה; קָרָה I)joist, beam, post.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 42">Gen. R. s. 42</cite>, a. e., v. <cite ref="P00178"><he>עוֹבִי</he></cite>.—<he>קוֹרַת בית הבד</he>, v. <cite ref="B00095"><he>בַּד</he> II</cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 12:1">Kel. XII, 1</cite> <he>קוֹרַת החצים</he> (not <he>קורות</he>) the (iron-shod) post used as a target for arrows; <he>של אסירין</he> the beam with holes for the hands of prisoners on a transport.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 3">Lam. R. to III, 12</cite>, v. <cite ref="H01487"><he>חֵץ</he></cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 11:2">Kel. XI, 2</cite> <he>הק׳</he> (Mish. ed. <he>הקורא</he>) the long iron bolt of a city gate (corresp. to <he>נגר</he>, v. Maim. ed. Dehr. a. l. expl. <he>נגר</he>).

senses.gloss: the trunk of a tree with its ramifications. Midr. Sam. ch. XIII, v. כְּוֶורֶת. Y. Sabb. X, 10ᵃ קורת שקמה the trunk of a sycamore tree; a. e.—Pl. קוֹרוֹת, קוֹרִים.
